node.statement: Application 1 (Limited entanglement tomography): Using the Mix+(GPS) moment formula (Theorem 1.6) with k-copy entangled measurements (k << n), the sample complexity for fidelity >= 1-epsilon on a rank-r state is n = O(max(d^3/(sqrt(k)*eps^2), d^2/eps^2)). This improves the prior best bounds and matches the Cramer-Rao lower bound in the large-k regime. Proof: Follow the median-of-means framework of [PSW25], using the second moment bound to control the variance of block estimators.
